profile.headline: Software Engineer at Medtronic CST
profile.summary: Passionate about leveraging technology to drive innovation in healthcare, I am a recent graduate from Northeastern University with a BS in Computer Science and Computer Engineering. With over a year of hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering within the medical devices industry, I’ve contributed to developing robust solutions that directly impact patient care and safety.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Enforce lab rules and safety, including food policy, noise levels, and sign-in processes
- Managing my own work schedule, covering other co-workers shifts, and reporting important information to manager
-  Submitting time cards by their deadline 
- Supply printers with paper and toner and keep the lab clean
- Assist students with any questions or concerns they have about the lab.

company.name: Northeastern University: College of Engineering Connections Lab

volunteerExperiences.description:
As a Steppingstone Ambassador, I was responsible for attending Family Information Meetings to share on stage, with the incoming families, my personal experiences at the program to help them decide whether they wanted to apply or not.
I volunteered at the Steppingstone HQ to assist with the organization of scholar files, the processing of admission applications, and updating student profiles through data entry.
Helped care for Franklin park by planting daffodils and removing invasive trees species

organizations.name: PrimesCircle @ MIT
organizations.description:
•	Learned college level game theory curriculum; developed creative and unique thinking strategies
•	Created projects based on curriculum to be presented to other students
•	Improved skills and basic knowledge with computer language: Latex
